ui.helpHowTo: A/D or arrows to walk. Space to mine. E to interact. F to send. I to inspect. RETURN to unload. Escape to close or stop. Click a vein to approach it or the floor to walk. Hold the direction buttons to walk on touch.
ui.interactHelp: E: pick up, load, or inspect
objective.shaftEnd: End of the known shaft at {depth}
objective.breakCore: Break the Core Shell; deliver the fragments
objective.keepCore: Reboot at the Core Chamber; keep the appraised Core
objective.inspectConnection: Inspect the next connection at the Lift
guide.appraisingContext: Cargo is being appraised at Surface. You can keep mining.
guide.toSurfaceContext: The loaded Elevator is carrying cargo to Surface. You can keep mining.
guide.loadingContext: Loading cargo. Move or press Esc to cancel without losing it.
guide.collectingContext: Picking up nearby cargo. Move or press Esc to cancel.
guide.returningContext: Following your return order. Movement keys or Esc interrupt it.
guide.waitingContext: You can leave the lift and keep mining with cargo.
guide.walkingContext: Walk with A/D or arrow keys; click a vein to approach it.
guide.miningContext: A late input queues one next swing. Repeated clicks never cancel the current swing.
guide.carryingContext: Keep mining with cargo, or choose RETURN / click the Elevator when you are ready to unload.
guide.pickUpContext: Ore stays on the floor. Press E / PICK UP nearby, or keep mining and collect it later.
guide.firstMineContext: Mine by clicking / tapping the vein again, pressing Space, or using MINE.
guide.nextMineContext: Ready for the next manual swing. You choose when to collect and return.
guide.sendContext: Press F or SEND beside the shaft to dispatch loaded cargo, without changing your selection.
status.openFromExtend: Open this floor from the EXTEND tab first.
status.waitLift: Wait for the lift to become available.
status.sendFirst: Send the loaded cargo to Surface first.
status.unloadBackpack: Unload your backpack, then send the cargo.
status.holdPorter: Hold Porter pickups in SHIP, then unload and send the cargo.
status.shipmentDescription: Send cargo to Surface. Paid on arrival.
access.escClose: Escape closes without clearing your vein.
access.escFacility: Escape cancels confirmation, then closes the facility.
access.arrowDestinations: Arrow keys browse destinations or controls.
workshop.pickDescription: Break rock with fewer swings. Finishing bonuses depend on the vein.
workshop.bootsDescription: Spend less time walking to veins and carrying ore back.
workshop.packDescription: Carry a full Copper Pocket batch in one trip. Can be bought before Auto Swing.
workshop.autoSwingDescription: Mines the vein you approach. Does not pick up or carry ore.
workshop.porterDescription: A worker picks up and carries ore. You still choose when to send the lift.
workshop.recoveredDescription: Browse by slot and compare all recovered equipment. Ownership transfers require confirmation.
workshop.relayDescription: Automatically dispatches eligible shipments. Turn it off when clearing the lift for a floor trip.
elevator.autoDispatchDescription: Automatically dispatches eligible shipments. Turn it off when clearing the lift for a floor trip.
elevator.routeDescription: Choose which waiting floor cargo gets the shared lift first. This changes routing, not the cargo already in transit.
elevator.holdDescription: Finish carried cargo, then stop new pickups to clear the lift for travel. Floor loot stays here. Resume manually or automatically after floor travel.
elevator.travelDescription: Unload cargo and empty the lift first.
management.choosePriority: Choose which waiting floor cargo the lift collects next. Payment arrives at Surface.
management.compareEquipment: Compare with the current equipment before fitting a replacement.
common.returnLater: Return later as the expedition progresses.
common.inspectPlans: Inspect PLANS for prerequisites and missing Data.
common.findRelics: Find and appraise more relics to reveal this passive.
common.passivesPersist: Unlocked and active passives persist across Reboot.
common.discoverRelic: Discover the matching relic and appraise it at Surface.
common.twoPassivesActive: Two passives are active. Deactivate one before activating another.
common.identifySurface: Bring this discovery to Surface to identify it.
common.noStacking: Activate in PASSIVES (two slots). Duplicates sell for Scrap; effects never stack.
common.bringUnusual: Bring unusual cargo to Surface. The last 12 results stay here.
common.chooseOtherTab: Choose the other tab to inspect protocols.
common.anomalyLocked: This choice cannot be changed until Reboot. Inspect all responses before committing.
common.availableFirstCore: Available from the first Core expedition.
common.protocolPermanent: Permanent. Applies again at the start of each Run.
common.appraiseBeforeReboot: Appraise Core cargo at Surface before Reboot.
reset.gearReset: GEAR RESET: no equipment instance retained. Legacy Locker is required to keep one.
reset.lockerRule: The locker keeps your equipped tool, otherwise the highest rarity, then level.
reset.cargo: RESET: all unappraised cargo in the backpack, workers, lifts, floors and transport buffers. It is NOT included in the Core reward.
reset.optional: You can close this window and keep mining instead. Reboot is optional.
reset.resetValue: Run resources, buildings, research, crew and floors.
crew.openShift: Adds one Miner and converts the existing Porter into an assignable worker.
crew.compareEquipment: Compare with the current equipment before fitting a replacement.
crew.chooseDestination: Inspect to choose a destination, explicit priority, or equipment.
crew.hireOriginalPorter: Hire the original Porter at the workshop first.
crew.waitPorter: Wait for the Porter to finish unloading.
crew.fullSlots: All shift slots are occupied. Expand the shift first.
crew.addSlot: Adds one empty shift slot, not a worker. Hire separately.
crew.minesAssigned: Mines veins on the assigned floor.
crew.carriesOre: Carries ore to the lift collection point.
crew.assignAfterHire: Assign a floor and priority after hiring.
crew.schedulerUnavailable: Cargo Scheduler routing is not available.
crew.chooseNextCargo: Choose which waiting floor cargo the lift collects next. Payment arrives at Surface.
equipment.basicUpgrade: Basic tools are upgraded at the workshop.
equipment.compatibleEffects: Only effects compatible with this worker and task apply.
equipment.hitPowerNote: Hit power is before vein-specific finishing bonuses. Research weight is not a drop probability.
logistics.freightDescription: Carries cargo from the hub to Surface. Personnel use the Central Lift.
logistics.transportDisconnected: Transport disconnected. The Bore cannot send its output.
logistics.clearRoute: Clearing space in the transport route lets the Bore resume.
logistics.installBore: No walkway. Install a Bore to mine this vein.
logistics.engineerConnects: The Engineer connects its output to the transport line.
logistics.cargoToHub: Carry ore from the Rail Stop to the Cargo Hub by minecart.
anomaly.goldRushDescription: Less ordinary ore. Valuable finds become much more common.
anomaly.heavyWorldDescription: Workers move slowly, but everything appraises for more.
anomaly.emptyShaftDescription: Lift capacity shrinks; ascent and descent become much faster.
anomaly.fossilAgeDescription: Fossils surge while ordinary metal loses appraisal value.
anomaly.livingRockDescription: Nodes recover faster and yield more ordinary ore. Plan enough haul capacity.
anomaly.fragileRealityDescription: Brittle nodes and more anomalous finds, but fewer ordinary ore pieces.
passive.researchEchoDescription: Research cargo: +1 Data each at Surface.
passive.prospectorsEyeDescription: Read exact treasure odds and fossil/relic traces before committing.
passive.elevatorRhythmDescription: Dispatch at 85%+ load to accelerate that round trip.
passive.fossilHunterDescription: Fossil odds rise sharply, but ordinary ore appraises lower.
passive.longStrideDescription: The miner moves much faster while carrying nothing.
passive.lastSwingDescription: Finish a hit that would leave at most 15% HP, capped at 75% of that hit. Saves a swing on small remnants.
research.deepSurveyDescription: Expose research, fossil and rare signals on D-060 nodes.
research.priorityCargoTagDescription: Porter prioritizes Research, Relic and Core cargo.
research.strataScannerDescription: Reveal detailed node tendencies before mining.
research.coreResonanceDescription: Decode the Core Shell and authorize the D-100 extension.
research.crewRoutingDescription: Assign Miners and Porters to different floors.
research.cargoSchedulerDescription: Collect waiting cargo from several floors with the Central Elevator.
research.ancientSurveyDescription: Decode the signal below D-100 and authorize a shaft push toward D-180.
research.salvageAnalysisDescription: Expose more information about sealed equipment before appraisal.
research.lostSurveyDescription: Analyze the Lost Signal Sample and plot a safe route into The Lost.
research.railLogisticsDescription: Restore old horizontal rail and authorize Minecart cargo service.
research.freightArchitectureDescription: Authorize a cargo-only vertical Freight Cage for hub traffic.
research.nullGeometryDescription: Map disconnected platforms and inaccessible sites below The Lost.
research.remoteBoreControlDescription: Mine unreachable veins with a remote Bore.
research.deepShaftGeometryDescription: Turn recovered Deep Components into a construction plan for D-650.
protocol.experiencedHandsDescription: Start with Steel Pickaxe and Auto Swing already fitted.
protocol.cargoMemoryDescription: Start each Run with a Porter already on the floor.
protocol.shaftBlueprintDescription: D-030 shaft extension costs 70% less Scrap.
protocol.veteranElevatorDescription: Start with the Auto Dispatch relay already installed.
protocol.surveyArchiveDescription: Deep Survey begins completed from archived field notes.
protocol.crewManifestDescription: Begin the next Run with the first Miner already on the shift board.
protocol.freightMemoryDescription: Begin the next Run with Cargo Scheduler routing available.
protocol.legacyLockerDescription: Keep one recovered piece of equipment for the next Run.
protocol.railBlueprintDescription: Retain the restored Rail plan so its blueprint step is skipped next Run.
protocol.freightCharterDescription: Retain Freight Cage authorization and skip its blueprint stage next Run.
protocol.engineerLicenseDescription: Begin future Runs with Engineer service already licensed.
protocol.boreMemoryDescription: Retain the Remote Bore blueprint after Reboot.
protocol.deepSurveyArchiveDescription: Keep the Lost survey record and shorten the repeated deep survey chain.
guide.movingToVeinContext: Moving to {name}. Movement keys or Esc override this order.
guide.nodeRespawning: {name} is respawning. You can choose another vein.
guide.chooseVeinContext: {name} · click or tap the vein to approach it, or walk with A/D and arrow keys.
elevator.travelDescriptionFull: Travel to this floor{viaSurface}. Unload cargo and empty the lift first.
readout.trip: Haul about {seconds}s round trip; average ore {weight}kg
survey.prospect: {signal} · {remaining} breaks to extract · stays until mined
crew.carried: Carried: {weight} kg. Unloads before taking the lift to another floor.
crew.startsOn: Starts on {depth}. Assign a floor and priority after hiring.
equipment.ownerLoses: {owner} will lose this item and its effects.
reset.coreShell: CORE SHELL: {remaining}/4 still in the rock this Run. Other depths have their own finite reserves.
reset.metaKeep: KEEP: {protocols} Core Protocols, {finds} collection discoveries and Best Depth {depth}.
reset.passiveKeep: KEEP: {unlocked} unlocked / {active} active passives, equipment and deep discovery records.
reset.legacyLocker: LEGACY LOCKER: {name} ({rarity}, Lv.{level}) is the one retained equipment instance.
reset.floors: RESET: {count} connected floors → D-001. Buildings, assignments and this Run's Anomaly reset.
reset.nextRun: NEXT RUN: research {research}, crew {crew}, tool level {level}. Permanent protocols determine the starting setup.
reset.loseValue: {count} other gear and ALL undelivered cargo.
feedback.shiftExpanded: Shift expanded to {slots} slots. Hire another worker.
feedback.firstShift: First shift opened. Assign your workers.
feedback.buildRail: Engineer dispatched to restore the D-250 Rail.
feedback.buildFreight: Engineer dispatched to build the Freight Cage.
feedback.installBore: Engineer dispatched to install the Bore.
shipment.title: SURFACE APPRAISAL
work.firstLiftLoad: FIRST LOAD DELIVERED TO THE LIFT
work.firstFloorLoad: FIRST LOAD DELIVERED TO FLOOR CARGO
work.firstLoadLift: FIRST LOAD DELIVERED TO THE LIFT
notice.shipmentSent: Shipment sent. Payment happens at Surface.
notice.connectionOpen: {name}: connection open. Choose TRAVEL to visit.
facility.title: BASE FACILITIES
facility.surfaceAnalyzerDescription: Continue research and plan the next discovery.
facility.shiftBoardDescription: Hire, assign floors, set priorities and fit worker equipment.
facility.archiveDescription: Collection, active passives and permanent records.
facility.geologicalScannerDescription: Inspect the three Anomaly responses before choosing one.
facility.coreConsoleDescription: Inspect and install permanent Core Protocols.
facility.coreChamberDescription: Review Core gain, retained discoveries and everything that resets.
facility.deepLogisticsDescription: Find a bottleneck and adjust the route.
crew.priorityAny: Choose available veins without a specialist signal preference.
crew.priorityResearch: Favor research signals or physical Research cargo.
crew.priorityRare: Favor rare signals or higher-rarity cargo.
crew.priorityNearest: Favor the nearest eligible vein or cargo.
crew.priorityBalanced: Share the Central Elevator between waiting floor queues.
crew.requireRouting: Requires Crew Routing and Cargo Scheduler research. The Porter must finish unloading.
logistics.preferBulk: Prefer bulk cargo from the hubs.
logistics.balanceHubs: Balance cargo waiting at the hubs.
logistics.centralLift: The Central Lift still carries personnel and priority cargo.
progress.deliveredThisRun: Delivered or restored this Run. No manual opening is required.
progress.equipAndPersist: Equip recovered tools at the Workshop; collection records survive Reboot.
progress.persistRecords: Collection, equipment discoveries and deep records persist across Reboot.
progress.restorationReward: Restoration records a fossil only: no Scrap, Data, Core or passive reward.
progress.missingFossil: One missing fossil record, no resources.
survey.carryOre: Carry ore to the lift to unload. A full bag does not stop mining.
survey.ordinaryReturns: Ordinary ore returns. Revealed discoveries and Core reserves are finite within this Run.
logistics.connectToInspect: Connect D-400 to inspect Bore sites.
guide.loadCargoPayment: Press E or LOAD to transfer your cargo. Payment happens only at Surface.
elevator.returnBase: Return to D-001 to open this connection.
elevator.firstShipment: Deliver one shipment to Surface. Automation is optional for D-030.
elevator.travelD030: Travel to D-030 to open this connection.
elevator.chooseAnomaly: Choose an Anomaly at the D-030 scanner.
elevator.unlockPassive: Unlock a passive from an appraised find.
elevator.travelD060: Travel to D-060 to open this connection.
elevator.travelD100: Travel to D-100 to open this connection.
elevator.crewCargo: Unlock Crew Operations and Cargo Scheduler.
elevator.ancientResearch: Complete Ancient Survey and Cargo Scheduler research.
elevator.idleLift: Wait for an empty, idle lift and no cargo route.
elevator.finishCrewTransfers: Wait for Crew transfers to finish.
elevator.deliverLostSample: Deliver the Lost Signal Sample to Surface.
elevator.deliverNullSample: Deliver the Null Sample to Surface.
elevator.waitEngineer: Wait for the Engineer to finish the current job.
elevator.connectionOpen: Connection open. Select TRAVEL to visit this floor.
elevator.engineerBuild: Build a new shaft segment with the Engineer. Construction takes time; it does not move the miner.
elevator.openThenTravel: Open this connection, then select it in TRAVEL.
appraisal.onlyFossils: Only fossil specimens can be restored.
dispatch.balanced: 60% load, important cargo after 4s, any cargo after 15s. Rhythm waits for 85% when possible.
dispatch.bulk: 85% load to favor full batches and Rhythm. Any cargo leaves within 24s of loading.
dispatch.priority: Research, Core and equipment leave after 1.5s. Other cargo leaves at 55% load or within 8s.
crew.finishTransfer: Wait for the current transfer to finish.
crew.unloadBeforeAssign: Wait for this worker to unload carried cargo.
equipment.surveyLamp: Shows hidden Research signals before mining.
equipment.cargoHook: Assigned Porters bias toward rare physical cargo.
equipment.railSpikes: Rail loading favors bulky cargo before small low-value pieces.
equipment.haulMovement: Reduces the movement penalty of hauling physical cargo.
equipment.nullSites: Changes mining behavior around Null-type sites instead of being a global damage upgrade.
equipment.remoteTargets: Reveals remote-site and Bore target information.
equipment.physicalPriority: Makes cargo priority changes favor important physical objects.
equipment.remoteBoreBehavior: Changes connected Remote Bore hit behavior.
liftAnalyzer.required: Connect D-060 to use the Surface Analyzer.
